stories.title: 2 arrested in Gwinnett County after kidnapping victim slips note to business employees, police say
stories.summary: Police say Guillermo Gonzalez was abducted in South Carolina over a drug-related financial dispute before alerting workers at two local businesses.

stories.title: Police activity in Woodstock; Portion of Highway 92 blocked
stories.summary: All lanes on Highway 92 near Hames Road are shut down, police said.

stories.title: Police: Suspect on the run after armed robbery at Sandy Springs bank; FBI leading investigation
stories.summary: Police say an armed man demanded money and fled with a large amount of cash from Center State Bank on Sandy Springs Circle.

stories.title: Raccoon attacked by dog in Snellville tests positive for rabies, officials say
stories.summary: Anyone who may have been scratched or bitten by any stray animals or suspected rabid animals should seek medical care immediately.

stories.title: Traffic Alert: Person hit, killed by vehicle on I-285 NB in Atlanta, police say
stories.summary: Details are limited at this time.

stories.title: LIVE UPDATES: Army detonates nation's stockpile of lead azide in Iowa
stories.summary: After several delays, the U.S. Army has detonated a stockpile of lead azide that officials say is unsafe to move due to the risk of spontaneous explosion.

stories.title: US Army releases post-detonation maps of potential lead dust exposure
stories.summary: The Army and EPA have said that initial monitoring has not shown any concentrations of lead in the air. Surface sampling and testing is still underway.

stories.title: Atlanta rapper 2 Chainz says he broke his ribs in head-on collision on social media post
stories.summary: A video posted on his Instagram shows two vehicles, an orange Monster Cybertruck and a gray sedan, that appear to be totaled.

stories.title: Man arrested in Florida, charged with murder in connection to 3-year-old's death in Atlanta
stories.summary: The child died from a gunshot wound following a late-night shooting in April in the Peoplestown neighborhood.

stories.title: 16-year-old boy killed in northwest Atlanta shooting identified
stories.summary: The Fulton County Medical Examiner's Office identified the teen as Daniel Franklin, 16. He died Tuesday at Grady Memorial Hospital.

stories.title: Crash survivor works with local group to support needs of traffic violence victims
stories.summary: Atlantans for Safe Streets, a local group that supports traffic violence victims has relaunched after the recent vigil in Cabbagetown.

stories.title: Traffic Alert: Heavy police presence on I-20 Westbound causing delays in Douglas Co.
stories.summary: Details are limited at this time.
